description: A Python script for parsing, normalizing, and de-duplicating paths in Breakpad symbol files, including classes for handling symbol records and error management.

classes.name: BreakpadParseError
classes.description: Custom exception class for unsupported Breakpad symbol records.

classes.name: SymbolFileParser
classes.description: Class responsible for parsing Breakpad symbol files, normalizing paths, and handling duplicate file entries.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Processes the input stream line by line, parsing and outputting modified records.

methods.name: _ParseRecord
methods.description: Parses a single line record, delegating to specific handlers based on record type.

methods.name: _NormalizePath
methods.description: Normalizes a file path to its canonical form.

methods.name: _AdjustPath
methods.description: Adjusts the path after normalization, removing ignored prefixes.

methods.name: _ParseFileRecord
methods.description: Parses and deduplicates a FILE record, updating internal mappings.

methods.name: _IsLineRecord
methods.description: Determines if a record is a line record based on its type.

methods.name: _ParseLineRecord
methods.description: Parses and updates a line record with deduplicated file index.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function to set up options, instantiate parser, and process the symbol file.
